authority_note: Execution delegated to the executing agent by the author; seeds and analysis rules are locked here before any confirmation result is inspected.
purpose: Bring the two qualified external candidates to five seeds each (add seeds 7 and 13), add sample-aware uncertainty on the population endpoint, and produce a cross-dataset forest/heterogeneity summary. This is a confirmation layer on top of the locked phase-2 protocol; it does not modify the frozen internal primary result, the manuscript, or the submission gate.
seed_choice_rule: Deterministic and result-independent: 7 and 13 are the smallest positive integers not already used by any arm of this project (42/123/2026 are used by the internal freeze, both externals, pure-MSE, and the random controls). They were chosen and this record was committed before any seed-7/13 run was started.

datasets.replicate_note: GEO sample/library groups are not independent animal replicates; the source study pooled biological material before profiling. Protocol/seed-level inference only.
one pooled RNA sample per timepoint; no biological-replicate inference

unchanged_from_phase2_protocol: training entry point (ode_benchmark/train_ode_benchmark.py, unmodified; its sha256 is recorded in every artifact)
hyperparameters, epoch cap 100, early-stopping patience 15, min epochs 20, internal validation fraction 0.1
failure-boundary policy: every endpoint is retained and reported, including negative or null results
explicitly_not_changed: frozen internal primary result (primary_internal_freeze) and all its artifacts
private publication materials excluded from this release
the committed 3-seed phase-2 aggregate; it remains as the historical record

analysis_plan.confirmation_aggregate: Five-seed per-endpoint mean/SD plus exact 3125-resample seed bootstrap, written to artifacts/reports/external_phase3_aggregate_v2.json and external_phase3_report_v2.md
analysis_plan.sample_aware_uncertainty: Cell-level and sample-cluster bootstrap of the population-mean endpoint (resampling cells, and for GSE148794 resampling its 10 sample libraries per timepoint). GSE149622 has a single pooled sample per timepoint, so only the cell-level bootstrap is defined there and it is flagged accordingly. This quantifies data-sampling noise, not training variance; the model arms are reported as fixed seed estimates.
analysis_plan.cross_dataset_meta: Forest plot of the ODE - GRU difference across all completed endpoints (internal freeze 27->36 and 27->48; GSE148794 9->12 and 9->15; GSE149622 3->4; GSE224518 3->5 and 3->8; GSE226824 24->72) with a DerSimonian-Laird I-squared heterogeneity summary computed descriptively. Endpoints are not exchangeable (different datasets, protocols and horizons), so the pooled numbers are reported as descriptive only and are not promoted to a claim.
analysis_plan.pure_mse_external: Deferred: the degraded claim ('dataset/horizon-dependent architecture effect') does not depend on pathway-specific benefit, and the internal pure-MSE null already covers the mechanism question. Recorded here so the skip is a plan, not an omission.

decision_rules.if the ODE - GRU direction stays negativ: Keep the dataset/horizon-dependent framing from the phase-2 boundary audit; no claim change.
decision_rules.if per-dataset direction flips across se: Report both directions and the widened interval; treat the endpoint as unstable rather than selecting seeds.
decision_rules.if a new seed fails (exit != 0 or epochs: Record the failure as a boundary, do not retry with different seeds, and exclude only that run from aggregates with the failure documented.
